name: Electricity Power Cut & Overdue Bill Scam (English)

caller_script.text: Dear consumer, this is State Electricity Distribution Head Office. Your last month electricity bill has not been updated in our database. Your power connection will be cut tonight at 9 PM.
To prevent disconnection, you must immediately update your security deposit through our online portal. Do not delay.
Pay immediately to our emergency bill clearance UPI handle: powerboard dot support at the rate ok axis. powerboard.support@okaxis.
